messages:
SRE-Bot: ALERT -> High p95 inference latency detected for hosted model 'redwood-small' in us-west-2. p95 = 1.35s over 10m. Severity: P2. Paging on-call. Runbook: /runbooks/inference-latency.

Alex (eng-oncall): on it. grabbing metrics and checking autoscale events.

Maria - SRE: taking pager. quick sanity checks: 1) GPU util 2) queue length 3) KV cache hit rate 4) recent deploys. I'll post findings. @Jordan FYI in case we need infra changes.

Alex (eng-oncall): metrics snapshot: GPU util avg 70% on the podset, but request queue depth spiked ~2x 12m ago. autoscaler did not add replicas (min replicas hit?). No recent deploys in last 30m.

Maria - SRE: sounds like batching/queueing issue + min replica floor. Trying to scale replicas manually to relieve queue. Running:
```
kubectl scale deployment/redwood-inference-usw2 --replicas=8 -n inference-prod
```

Maria - SRE: also flushing prefix KV cache for model variant to remove bad entries:
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/cache/flush" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","scope":"prefix"}'
```

Leo - Prod Infra: if you're scaling, consider adding a temporary burst pool rule to allow oversubscribe on spare gpus. will coordinate with scheduler.

Jordan: if scaling doesn't reduce p95 within 5-10m, we should failover traffic to redwood-small-quant (compatible) in the same region to reduce latency. Prep the fallback route:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","model_override":"redwood-small-quant","weight":100}
```
(not literal curl, just route config snippet)

Alex (eng-oncall): posting status page draft (internal) for review: "Investigating elevated inference latency in us-west-2 affecting text-generation API. Engineers are mitigating by scaling capacity and flushing caches. Some requests may experience higher latency or transient errors. We will provide updates within 15 minutes." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Maria - SRE: that's good. Add impact line: "Impact: Increased p95 for a subset of public hosted customers and internal QA environments. No data loss reported." Also include ETA to next update.

CS-Notifier-Bot: Suggested customer-facing blurb (short): "We are currently investigating elevated API latency in the US‑West region. We are actively scaling capacity and expect service restoration within 30 minutes. We will send updates as we have more info."

Maria - SRE: scaled to 8 replicas at 1968004525. p95 dropped to 0.9s after 90s, queue length trending down. continuing monitoring.

Alex (eng-oncall): good improvement. still above SLO (0.6s). Maria, did the KV flush complete?

Maria - SRE: KV flush succeeded at 1968004600. hit rate recovered from 12% to 38% for hot prefixes. p95 now 0.58s at 1968004680. marking as mitigated for customer impact.

SRE-Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> Mitigation in place. p95 back within acceptable SLO. No broad errors reported. Keep monitoring for 1 hour.

Jordan: preparing post-incident communications and internal template. Internal comms snippet (for execs):
"Timeline: 1968004321 alert -> 1968004525 manual scale -> 1968004600 cache flush -> 1968004680 p95 recovered. Impact: transient elevated latency for hosted API in us-west-2 affecting a subset of customers. Root cause: under investigation (likely autoscaler floor + cache churn). Action taken: manual scale, cache flush, increased observability. Next steps: RCA and autoscaler policy tweaks."

Alex (eng-oncall): Customer-facing update (short): "We've mitigated an incident causing increased latency in US‑West. Services are operating within normal latency ranges. If you continue to see issues, please open a support ticket and reference incident #1968004321. We will follow up with a detailed post‑mortem"

CS-Notifier-Bot: queued customer notifications to customers with impacted usage > threshold. Sending now.

Maria - SRE: handing off monitoring to Jordan for the next 60m. leaving a checklist for handoff: 
- watch p95 (1m/5m)
- watch queue depth per shard
- monitor KV cache hit %
- confirm no rollouts happening in region
- follow up on autoscaler logs

Jordan: ack taking over at 1968004705. will escalate back to oncall if p95 > 0.8s for 10m or errors spike.

Leo - Prod Infra: creating temporary alert tweak to catch autoscaler floor conditions and inform runbook owners.

SRE-Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> 1968004680 mitigation effective; moving to monitoring. Post-mortem TODO assigned.

Alex (eng-oncall): quick note for postmortem: include autoscaler min-replicas thresholds per model class, cache eviction pattern, and a sim test for burst traffic at 2x normal. Also capture cost/ops tradeoffs for keeping spare capacity.

Jordan: will draft RCA and send to ops-review group. ETA for draft: 48 hours. Closing thread but will update when RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
